statement: Run one disposable restart trial on smoke-firejail5: one task, one bee, one dispatch, one coordinator stop and one restart. This authorizes the trial run only.

tasks.objective: Create smoke/answer.py with a single function answer() that returns the integer 42. Do not modify any other file.

commands: /usr/bin/python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); import tests.test_smoke as t; t.test_answer_is_42()"

coordinator.stop: after the first dispatch, after the worker is observed running; confirm the actual driver PID exited
coordinator.restart: one restart only; one overall deadline covers both driver runs and the downtime

python_contexts.worker: real; owned by smoke-firejail5/launcher, never started or stopped by the harness

suite_command: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); import tests.test_smoke as t; t.test_answer_is_42()

approval.secret: BUNDLEBEES_APPROVAL_SECRET in the Hermes secret scope (value never recorded)
